programme.desc: Live in London 2013: Lady Gaga - (concert film, England, 2013) Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: Aura; MANiCURE; Artpop; Jewels N' Drugs ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista; Sexxx Dreams, Swine; and I Wanna Be With You, a song that transformed into Dope for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's a bit like Dorothy right now. The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.

programme.title: Strat Pack - 50 Years of the Fender Stratocaster
programme.desc: The Strat Pack: Live in Concert - (concert film, England, 2004) In 1954, Leo Fender gave the electric guitar a new sound and look that fully set it apart from its acoustic counterpart with the invention of the Fender Stratocaster, a solid-body electric axe with a revolutionary three-way pickup system and a modern, streamlined design that was like nothing else on the market at the time. Early rock 'n' rollers such as Buddy Holly and Dick Dale quickly embraced the Stratocaster, and since then it has become the guitar of choice for legendary players such as Jimi Hendrix, Eric Clapton, Stevie Ray Vaughan, Keith Richards, Bonnie Raitt, Mark Knopfler, and dozens of others. The Strat Pack: Live in Concert documents a special concert held at London's Wembley Arena in the fall of 2004, in which a stellar lineup of great rock guitarists came out to say Happy 50th Birthday to the Stratocaster. Performers include Joe Walsh, Ron Wood, David Gilmour, Brian May, Albert Lee, Hank Marvin, and many more.

programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Deep Purple - Live in Verona - (concert film, Italy, 2011) Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from the summer of 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks. Deep Purple remains one of the finest hard rock bands on the planet and are undoubtedly at their best when performing live. Here, the orchestral arrangements give an added depth and range to the familiar songs. The band responds to both playing with the orchestra and performing in such a historical location to deliver a brilliant show in front of a huge and enthusiastic crowd.

His distinctive guitar picking style and instantly recognisable voice are joined to his dynamic on stage presence to deliver a show that brings the audience to their feet and leaves them calling for more. Starting with five solo acoustic performances, Lindsey is then joined by his band to rock their way through the rest of the set before a final acoustic encore of Seeds We Sow brings a perfect evening to an end., R.: Lindsey Buckingham, Ul.: Lindsey Buckingham (Self)

programme.title: Avaz Gündem

programme.title: Čovjek kojeg nije bilo
programme.desc: Postavljena u tihi gradić 40-tih godina filmska zvijezda braće Coen, Billy Bob Thornton, glumi skromnog brijača koji sumnja da ga supruga Doris (Frances McDormand) vara sa šefom.

programme.title: Udovice
programme.desc: Četiri žene koje nemaju ništa zajedničko osim duga koji su im ostavili njihovi pokojni muževi upleteni u kriminal, uzimaju sudbinu u svoje ruke i kuju zavjeru da stvore budućnost pod svojim uvjetima.

programme.title: Crveni zmaj
programme.desc: Nakon što je uhitio dr.

programme.title: Istjerivači duhova 2
programme.desc: Otkriće ogromne rijeke ektoplazme i ponovno pojavljivanje spektralne aktivnosti omogućuje osoblju Istjerivača duhova da ožive posao.

programme.title: Preko ograde
programme.desc: Lukavi rakun vara neusklađenu obitelj šumskih stvorenja kako bi mu pomogli otplatiti dug hrane, napadajući novo prigradsko naselje koje je nastalo tijekom njihove hibernacije.

programme.title: Ljudi u crnom 3
programme.desc: Agent J putuje kroz vrijeme u rane dane MIB-a 1969. godine kako bi spriječio izvanzemaljca da ubije njegovog prijatelja agenta K i promijeni povijest.

programme.title: Čovjek-pauk
programme.desc: Tobey Maguire je Peter Parker, zvani Spider-Man. Jedan je od najpopularnijih superjunaka iz stripova svih vremena. U ovoj akcijskoj avanturi nominiranoj za Oscara, gledamo ga na velikom platnu.

programme.title: Stuart Mali 2
programme.desc: Michael J. Fox posuđuje glas Stuartu Malom u nastavku o šarmantnom sićušnom junaku Stuartu. Ovaj put mora putovati kroz grad kako bi spasio novog prijatelja, Margala, od zlikovca.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: Kada neobični izvanzemaljac oboji Spider-Manovo odijelo u crno, njegovi najmračniji demoni izlaze na vidjelo. Spider-Man je u borbi svog života, a u glavnoj ulozi je Tobey Maguire.

programme.title: Najluđi radijski show
programme.desc: Zavirite iza pozornice tijekom posljednjeg emitiranja najpoznatijeg američkog radijskog showa u kojem se pojavljuju raspjevani kauboji Dusty i Lefty, zvijezda country glazbe i mnoštvo drugih.

programme.title: Junfer u četrdesetoj

programme.title: Nevidljivi
programme.desc: Žena koja živi u zamračenoj staroj kući sa svoje dvoje fotoosjetljive djece, uvjerena je da je njezin dom uklet.

programme.title: Van zakona
programme.desc: Grupa ljudi koji se osjeća izdano od vlade i iznevjereno od strane policijskih snaga, formira modernu odmetničku postrojbu kako bi ispravili ono što vide kao društvenu nepravdu.

programme.title: Dobro došao kući, Rosco Jenkinse
programme.desc: Uspješni domaćin talk shawa odlazi iz Los Angelesa da bi posjetio svoju obitelj koja živi na Jugu.

programme.title: Istjerivači duhova 3

programme.title: Stuart Mali
programme.desc: Geena Davis i Hugh Laurie su par koji se nada da će posvojiti mlađeg brata za svog sina. Umjesto toga, kući odvode Stuarta, šarmantnog miša nalik čovjeku.
